informUserConsent.title: We Value Your Privacy
informUserConsent.content:
Before we proceed, please acknowledge that we’ll be collecting and processing the following personal information:

  • Name (for identification & security)
  • Company/Organization (to verify affiliation)
  • Contact Information (phone number and/or email)
  • Driver’s License, NIC/Passport Number (official ID number)
  • Purpose of Visit (reason for visiting)
  • Visitor Sign‑in/Out Time (arrival & departure timestamps)
  • Facial Image (captured and stored securely for visitor identification, security verification, access control, and audit trail purposes. Images will be retained according to our data retention policy)

To continue using this service, please confirm that you agree to our Privacy Policy and the processing of your personal data in compliance with GDPR.
